item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda sits down with Rebecca Mendoza, the owner of Rebecca & Co. Rebecca also shares her experience working with Wolf Creek Brewery from its inception, ultimately becoming the restaurant manager before becoming a real estate agent.
